items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Sinclair, the other bass player was on that band.

ctx.x: Well, wasn't the band awful mad at that?

You better know it. See, that's what made the band get sick and people started to going away, you know, because at that time we had a hell of a band. We had two bass players. Milton Buckner on piano, Charlie Harris, who left Hampton, went with Nat King Cole out of Baltimore, Maryland, and stayed with Nat until he died. Sinclair, the other bass player was on that band. He was killed in an accident by getting panicky and jumped out of the car before the accident occurred. He saw it coming up and jumped out, and…
That was one of the finest bands of all time out of the fiye years I was there, that band we had. Herbert Field was on that band.
